functions.extraction: Remove material or an object from a substrate, cavity or body.
functions.crushing: Reduce or deform material through compressive force.
functions.cutting: Separate material with an edge; includes slicing and shearing.
functions.gripping: Hold or stabilize an object through contact or clamping.
functions.scraping: Remove surface material by moving an edge across it.
functions.probing: Explore a space or tissue through contact without assuming cutting.

pair_dimensions.shape: Similarity of visible projected form. Photos are uncalibrated.
pair_dimensions.mechanism: Similarity of working action, contact and actuation, if evidence permits.
pair_dimensions.function: Similarity of documented or hypothesized task. Distinguish its evidence.
